description: C50 — 认识轻子，每步出新子

intro.popup_en: Rapid Development, Lesson 1: Knights and bishops are minor pieces, each worth about three points. Develop them early, bringing out a new piece with each move and avoiding unnecessary repetition.
intro.popup:
快速出子第1课
马象是轻子都是价值3分， 应在开局优先出动，每步走一个新子，尽量不要重复

outro.popup_en: Recognizing minor pieces and developing them first is a basic opening principle.
outro.popup: 总结：认识轻子，优先发展，是开局基本原则

moves.popup_en: e4 occupies the center, controlling d5 and f5 from the first move.
moves.popup:
e4占领中心
开局第一步：占中心格
控制d5和f5

moves.popup_en: ...e5 mirrors White's central occupation, creating a symmetrical position.
moves.popup:
e5对称
黑方也占中心
对称局面

moves.popup_en: Nf3! White develops the first minor piece. The knight attacks e5 and controls d4.
moves.popup:
Nf3！第1个轻子出动
马是轻子之一
攻击e5兵，同时控制d4

moves.popup_en: ...Nc6 develops Black's first minor piece and protects e5.
moves.popup:
Nc6出动
黑方第1个轻子
保护e5兵

moves.popup_en: Bc4! White develops the second minor piece. The Italian bishop targets f7.
moves.popup:
Bc4！第2个轻子出动
象是轻子之一
意大利开局，瞄准f7

moves.popup_en: ...Bc5 develops Black's second minor piece symmetrically.
moves.popup:
Bc5出动
黑方第2个轻子
对称发展

moves.popup_en: d3 stabilizes the center and leaves room for Nc3 in the closed Italian setup.
moves.popup:
d3稳固中心
为Nc3让路
意大利封闭体系

moves.popup_en: ...Nf6 develops Black's third minor piece, attacks e4, and prepares castling.
moves.popup:
Nf6出动
黑方第3个轻子
攻击e4，准备易位

moves.popup_en: Nc3! White develops the third minor piece. All three of White's minor pieces are active, so castling can now be considered.
moves.popup:
Nc3！第3个轻子出动
白方3个轻子全部出动
现在可以考虑易位了！

moves.popup_en: ...d6 stabilizes Black's position; Black's remaining minor piece is ready to develop.
moves.popup:
d6稳固
黑方第4个轻子待出

moves.popup_en: O-O! White castles as soon as the minor pieces are developed. The king is safe and the rooks are connected.
moves.popup:
O-O！白方易位
轻子出动后立即易位
王安全，车连通

moves.popup_en: ...O-O! Black also castles. Both kings are safe and the middlegame begins.
moves.popup:
O-O！黑方也易位
双方王都安全了
进入中局阶段

moves.popup_en: h3 prevents a possible ...Be6 and ...Bg4 pin against White's knight.
moves.popup:
h3防护
防止Be6-Bg4牵制
细节处理

moves.popup_en: ...Be6 develops Black's fourth minor piece.
moves.popup:
Be6出动
黑方第4个轻子出动

moves.popup_en: Bb3 retreats the bishop to avoid an unfavorable exchange.
moves.popup:
Bb3象撤退
避免被兑换亏损

moves.popup_en: ...Bxb3 exchanges bishops and simplifies the position.
moves.popup:
Bxb3兑换
黑方简化局面

moves.popup_en: axb3 recaptures and opens the a-file for White.
moves.popup:
axb3接回
白方开放a线

moves.popup_en: ...a6 prevents White from using Nb5.
moves.popup:
a6防护
阻止白棋Nb5

moves.popup_en: Bg5 develops the bishop actively and pins Black's knight on f6.
moves.popup:
Bg5出动
白方再激活象
牵制f6马

moves.popup_en: ...h6 challenges the bishop and asks it to move.
moves.popup:
h6逼象
黑方追击

moves.popup_en: Bxf6 exchanges bishops and simplifies the position.
moves.popup:
Bxf6兑换
简化局面

moves.popup_en: ...Qxf6 recaptures and activates Black's queen.
moves.popup:
Qxf6接回
黑方后活跃

moves.popup_en: d4! Both sides have developed their minor pieces and castled, so White is ready to advance in the center. Before completing development, d4 could have become a weakness.
moves.popup:
d4！推进中心
双方轻子全出，易位完毕
现在是推进中心的时候了！
此前若无发展，d4就是弱点
